architecture_comparison.benchmark_protocol: Apples-to-apples evaluation across all 5 tasks on identical thread-grouped zero-leakage splits (post_id grouped, seed=20261116) plus the untouched 54-probe unseen 8-category robustness benchmark.

why_transformer.selected_architecture: MuRIL-DAPT v3 Transformer (+ validation-calibrated Word+Char TF-IDF Hybrid)

key_reasons.title: Paraphrase, informal slang & parent-context comprehension
key_reasons.evidence: On paraphrased comments, informal Reddit slang, and parent-post context, MuRIL-DAPT v3 reaches 77.0%, 74.7%, and 70.4% OOD F1 (beating LogReg 50.5%, ANN 52.9%, and CNN 35.0% on paraphrases).

key_reasons.title: Smallest generalization drop across all 4 architectures
key_reasons.evidence: Bag-of-words LogReg, ANN (MLP), and scratch-trained 1D TextCNN overfit surface vocabulary (held-out -> unseen drop of 37.9-47.3 pp), whereas MuRIL-DAPT v3 cuts the drop to 28.7 pp (68.6% mean OOD Macro F1 across all 5 tasks).

key_reasons.title: Unsupervised domain adaptation (DAPT MLM) without label fabrication
key_reasons.evidence: Continuing Masked Language Modeling on 3,271 unlabeled real Reddit texts cut perplexity 37.185 -> 14.859, adapting representations to CAT/CAP/SAP/WL/LPA slang before fine-tuning.

key_reasons.title: Calibrated confidence + hybrid char-ngram complementarity
key_reasons.evidence: Temperature scaling + multi-sample dropout yield calibrated confidence (mean hybrid ECE 0.142), while blending with char-ngram TF-IDF helps on Romanized code-mixed keywords and compiles to read-only JSON served in <10 ms with zero GPU runtime.
